faqs.q: How much money must cardholders spend with their Biz Black credit card to receive the 5X reward points?
faqs.a: To avail the benefit of 5X rewards, i.e. 25 reward points per Rs. 150 spent, the HDFC Biz Black cardholders must reach the minimum monthly card spends worth Rs. 50,000.

faqs.q: What is the HDFC Biz Black fuel surcharge waiver?
faqs.a: HDFC Biz Black credit card does not offer any surcharge waiver on the fuel transactions made via the card.

faqs.q: Does HDFC Biz Black provide lounge access?
faqs.a: Yes, HDFC Biz Black Metal credit card offers unlimited complimentary lounge access to domestic and international airport lounges. This benefit is available for both active primary card members as well as add-on card users.

faqs.q: Can I get a loan on HDFC Biz Black credit card?
faqs.a: Yes, HDFC Bank Biz Black cardholders can get an Insta loan of any available amount within their assigned credit limit. The loan amount would be blocked against the remaining limit until repaid. Cardholders can also opt for Jumbo loan under which they can borrow a loan amount even beyond the available credit card limit without blocking any part of their credit limit.

faqs.question: Is the HDFC BizBlack Credit Card worth it?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you are a business owner or self-employed professional with significant annual tax payments and travel expenses. The card delivers its best value through accelerated rewards on eligible tax payments, SmartBuy benefits and milestone vouchers.

faqs.question: Does the HDFC BizBlack Credit Card offer rewards on Income Tax payments?
faqs.answer: Yes. Eligible Income Tax and advance tax payments can earn up to 5X Reward Points, subject to the minimum spending requirement and monthly accelerated reward cap.

faqs.question: What is the annual fee for the HDFC BizBlack Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The card carries a joining and annual renewal fee of ₹10,000 plus GST. The renewal fee is waived on annual spends of ₹7.5 lakh.

faqs.question: What is the forex markup on the HDFC BizBlack Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The card charges a 2% forex markup plus GST. Eligible international spends may also qualify for benefits under HDFC Bank's Global Value Program.

faqs.question: Who should apply for the HDFC BizBlack Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The card is best suited for business owners, sole proprietors and self-employed professionals who regularly make tax payments and can maximize the card's travel and reward benefits.
